details: Large body of practical ML tutorials Jason Brownlee (born January 30, 1999) is an American professional football wide receiver for the New York Giants of the National Football League (NFL). Brownlee also has played for the New York Jets and Kansas City Chiefs. He played college football for the Southern Miss Golden Eagles.

explainer.lead: Jason Brownlee is an American football player (born 1999).

contributions.name: Brownlee led the Southern Miss Golden Eagles with 34 receptions, 610 receiving yards, and five touchdown catches in his first season with the team.
He again led the team in receiving and was named second-team All-Conference USA after catching 46 passes for 643 yards and eight touchdowns in 2021.

timeline.what: He was named first-team All-State by The Clarion-Ledger as a senior after catching 42 passes for 967 yards and 11 touchdowns while West Point won the Class 5A state championship in 2017.
He caught 14 passes for 113 yards and a touchdown during his freshman season as the Lions won the 2018 NJCAA National Championship.
=== New York Jets === Brownlee was signed by the New York Jets as an undrafted free agent on May 5, 2023.
On August 28, 2024, Brownlee was waived by the Jets and re-signed to the practice squad.
